title: The Ancient Silk Road Now Has a Bullet Train — 1,776 km | China Travel Expert
description:
The camel-caravan Silk Road is now a high-speed rail line across the desert.

The Lanzhou–Urumqi high-speed railway runs 1,776 km — when it opened in 2014 it was the world's longest high-speed line built in a single stage, and most of it crosses the Gobi Desert. It slashed the Lanzhou–Urumqi trip from around 21 hours to under twelve. Along the way you roll past Jiayuguan, the western end of the Ming Great Wall, and Zhangye, gateway to the striped Danxia "rainbow" mountains.

🧭 Expert Tip: Don't ride it straight through — break the journey in Zhangye and give yourself half a day for the Danxia rainbow peaks at golden hour.

古丝绸之路now通了高铁：兰州到乌鲁木齐 1,776 公里，大半穿越戈壁。
